data.content_ref: inline:SRC_001's separating property is 'linearity' and it predicts that nonlinear rules will not satisfy the short-cycle criterion. But Rule 184 is nonlinear (its lookup table is 01110110, not affine over GF(2)), yet SRC_001 itself admits Rule 184 'settles into length-2 cycles within 4W' under its own overturn_conditions. This internally contradicts the proposed separator: if linearity is what guarantees short cycles, a nonlinear rule satisfying the criterion falsifies the property. SRC_001 thus cannot consistently use linearity as the structural separator while acknowledging a nonlinear rule meets the bound.
